source.publication: Schwab FOMC recap / CNBC FOMC minutes coverage (2026-10-07)

description: At its 2026-09-16 meeting the FOMC raised the federal funds target range 25bp to 3.75-4.00% by a 12-0 vote -- the first US hike of this cycle and the realisation of the hawkish guidance registered as cat_20260617_fed_hawkish_pivot. The 2026-10-07 minutes say most participants judge another increase 'likely appropriate by year end'; the 10-year auction that day cleared at 5.3% (24-year high) and 10y yields have held ~5.2-5.3% since. Hot September CPI (2026-10-14: 3.7% headline vs 3.6% expected, core 2.6% vs 2.5%) pushed October-hike odds from ~20% to 37-50% intraday, with a December hike priced ~81%. Registered as its own dated event because the earlier Fed event (event_date 2026-06-17, halflife 30d) has decayed to a few percent weight while the regime it describes strengthened: the hike was a DECIDED action, widely expected going in (consensus_surprise low), so strength sits just above the ECB hike. Same driver family as the ECB hike and the Hormuz energy shock (related ids), but a distinct decision by a distinct central bank, which is how cat_20260910_ecb_rate_hike was registered.

strength_anchors.note: Rubric total 55 (str_02+str_04+str_05): a single 25bp move priced at 85-90% is neither large nor a surprise. Set 60 because it is the first US hike of the cycle and the base of every long-duration discount rate, so it ranks above the ECB 25bp (56, second ECB hike) and below a supply-quota shock with a hard physical quantity (70).

user_notes: Registrado en el scan del 2026-10-17 (arrancado el 10-09). Responde a la pregunta del usuario del 10-07 'nos falta un catalizador para el regimen de tipos largos': NO se registra un estructural nuevo -- los estructurales solo SUMAN en catalyst_alignment (memoria catalyst-coverage-2026-07), asi que un headwind de tipos como estructural elevaria a los sectores que lo enlazan; el instrumento correcto es un evento con sector_impact adverse. Direccion por sector (JUICIO, confianza media): adverse en utilities/agua (coste de capital), biotech (duracion larga), ciber y data centers (multiplos / capex financiado), cobre (USD), oro fisico y mineras (tipo real; el oro cayo ~6% en septiembre pese a compras record de bancos centrales); supportive solo eu_retail_banking (curva global mas alta). Baja confianza: ciber (demanda resiliente, el golpe es de multiplo) y cobre. AVISO: los sectores solo ven este evento cuando su sector study lo lista en active_catalyst_ids -- hasta que el review actualice los studies de agua, biotech y los demas, el efecto sobre catalyst_alignment es cero salvo grid/ciber/cobre/oro/ai_infra/eu_banking, que ya listan el evento de junio. Las fechas clave: Fed 2026-10-28 (odds de subida ~18% antes del CPI, 37-50% tras el) y BCE 2026-10-29.
